response_body.job_summary: This is a plumbing fixture/appliance swap. Based on Flagstaff's permit rules, the faucet replacement may be exempt if it is truly a like-for-like replacement on the existing supply lines with no pipe work, but the garbage disposal replacement is still plumbing/mechanical-adjacent work that Flagstaff treats under its plumbing permit process when a regulated plumbing system is being altered or replaced. For this scope, the safe permit call is a Plumbing Permit for the disposal replacement; no separate building, electrical, or mechanical permit is triggered by the stated scope unless new wiring, a new circuit, or drain/supply relocation is added.
pro_tips: If the faucet is truly a like-for-like swap with no pipe relocation, keep it separate in your scope notes so the city sees the disposal replacement as the only permit-triggering item.
Have the disposal model number ready before you apply; inspectors often want to know the unit is listed and properly installed.
In Arizona, ROC license information should be entered exactly as it appears on the contractor record — mismatched license numbers are a common portal rejection.
